messages:
morgan: Quick async stand — posting the delivery snapshot for Optimize toolkit (quant recs + batching/caching).
morgan: TL;DR: feature branch ready, need final quant review + canary plan. Regression flag on cache_kv_eviction seen in staging.
morgan: Owners: priya=quant, ben=batching, sasha=infra, morgan=pm. Dependencies: cache v2 rollout, canary infra toggle.
priya: quick heads-up — running full eval now. early numbers look okay but need to settle accuracy drop threshold. is 0.5% acceptable or do we hold to 0.25%?
ben: for production I'd aim <=0.5% drop for non-critical prompts. for high-sensitivity routes we should default to fp16 variant. baseline is in the PR description.
morgan: @priya @ben propose 0.5% global threshold, have route-level overrides for sensitive flows. agrees?
priya: sounds good. I'll flag routes that need stricter limits.
sasha: infra note — cache v2 rollout is scheduled Tue 22:00 PT; if we depend on it for KV prefix caching we should avoid canary before Wed morning. also need nodepool bump for the new driver.
ben: re batching: default batch size bump looks safe. one API change needed: pass context_size in /infer call. updated the shim in the branch.
priya: quick numbers from evalset "optkit-regress-2024": int8 avg latency +2ms, p95 -10ms, quality delta -0.6% (macro-F1). most failures are length-sensitive prompts.
ben: can we add a per-route fallback to fp16 when quality drop > threshold? I can add the flag and rollout switches.
priya: please do. also add an eval hook that logs route/length so we can triage.
ci-bot: CI: 12 checks passed, 1 failed — tests/cache_kv_eviction (flaky). See: https://ci.redwood/1709/PR/482
ben: I'll take the flaky test. pushing a retry now.
morgan: I've created a quick ticket to track the canary checklist and rollback steps: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-7421
morgan: Proposed canary window: Wed 09:00–12:00 PT, 10% traffic for 2h then 25% if no regressions. objections?
priya: ok from quant side. will monitor eval hooks and post live numbers.
sasha: infra ack, I'll coordinate the nodepool bump during the 02:00 maintenance window to avoid tail risk.
ben: added fallback variant + rollout flag in the branch. link: https://git.redwood/optimize/PR-482
priya: approving once we have the fallback and eval hook in place.
morgan: thanks — action items: ben add fallback (in progress), priya add route list and monitor, sasha confirm nodepool bump scheduled, ben rerun flaky test, morgan will own canary runbook and tickets.
morgan: small rollout config snippet for the runbook:
\`\`\`
rollout:
  stage1: {pct: 10, duration: 120m, checks: [latency, quality, errors]}
  stage2: {pct: 25, duration: 120m}
fallback_policy:
  route_sensitive: fp16
  default: int8_with_fallback
\`\`\`
morgan: pinging owners for final thumbs before I kick off the canary doc: @priya @ben @sasha
ben: thumbs, will push final commits and ping when CI is green. :white_check_mark:
priya: thumbs. will start the monitoring dashboard and alerts. :eyes:
sasha: ack. will coordinate infra ops. :rocket:
morgan: cool — will update INF-7421 and mark milestone target Wed morning. thanks all.
